summary: Authority capacity mining found a bounded follow-on liveness gap not covered by retained PR #412: the harness publishes the mutable lab Model through the owned RealizedLab-shaped handle, but reconciliation observes only root Destroying/AncestryChanged and exact root Parent drift. A caller can destructively mutate descendants (for example ClearAllChildren or destroy/reparent one canonical representation) without changing the root Parent, leaving Harness.get() bound to the same owner. The Realizer's current isRepresented() presence check is based on a non-nil private-map reference, so a destroyed/reparented representation reference can remain logically present until a stronger exact-instance predicate or validation path is invoked. Retained PR #349 adds ownsRepresentation() for diagnostics and can fail closed on stale/destroyed candidates, but it is not consumed by the harness and does not reconcile harness ownership. Queue a narrow descendant/representation-liveness follow-on only after the retained #348/#394/#412 authority stack and #349 can integrate; do not spawn another authority primary while trusted ownership is blocked, and do not treat this source finding as Studio/two-client evidence.
evidence: PR #412 exact head 807fb042b2fe96db32bda7a5c3346788e828a758 clones the RealizedLab-shaped handle and therefore still exposes realized.model; its reconcileExternalLifecycle() returns live whenever realized.model.Parent equals expectedParent, and its asynchronous hooks are only realized.model.Destroying and realized.model.AncestryChanged.

A descendant-only destructive mutation does not require the root Model Parent to change, so #412's synchronous Parent preflight and root lifecycle signals do not observe that class of corruption before get()/start() ownership decisions.

PhysicsLabRealizer keeps representations in a private entityId->Instance map and isRepresented() derives physical presence from representations[entityId] ~= nil; destroying or reparenting the referenced Instance does not itself nil that Lua table entry.

Retained PR #349 exact head ee771bd50db972ad572f5d3cef8463220d69fa06 adds ownsRepresentation(entityId, candidate), requiring exact private-map Instance identity plus direct membership under the realized model, and its lane explicitly limits that seam to diagnostics consumption rather than harness lifecycle recovery.

Search of current authority PR lineage found no ClearAllChildren/DescendantRemoving or equivalent descendant-liveness repair, while HG-COMPLETION-AUTHORITY is explicitly BLOCKED and instructs workers not to start another authority primary until trusted-history/live pr-ownership recovers.

Docs/PHYSICS_LAB_STUDIO_RUNBOOK.md treats the harness as the production lifecycle boundary and explicitly says not to manually delete the lab model; this finding is source-only resilience hardening and does not claim Roblox Studio, viewport, physical-contact, or true two-client evidence.
